tasks.text: Yesterday, Tom walked slowly in the quiet park. He looked around carefully because he had a new camera. A little boy played happily with a red ball near the big tree. Suddenly, a dog barked loudly behind the green bushes. Tom did not run away, but he moved silently away from the dog. He wanted to take a nice photo of the cute animal, so he waited patiently. Finally, the dog stopped barking and walked away.

tasks.text: Every student wants to succeed in life. If you study hard every single day, you will earn good marks and find a great job in the future. Sometimes a difficult problem appears in class, but you can always find a good solution if you think carefully. You must also save your money and never waste it on useless things. If you borrow money from your friend, you will need to return it on time. Otherwise, you will create a bad situation and lose a good friend.
